introduction: HELP4TN offers legal information and tools, alongside a free legal-advice helpline specifically for people age 60 or older.
description: HELP4TN offers legal information and tools, alongside a free legal-advice helpline specifically for people age 60 or older.

sections.who: The website’s information can be explored directly. Its senior helpline serves people 60 and above regardless of income or assets.
sections.get: Resources include legal guides, forms and topic-specific chatbots. Advice and representation depend on the service used.
sections.docs:
• Legal notices and dates.
  • A concise description of the issue.
  • Safe contact information.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the appropriate service

    Use HELP4TN’s topic links or Legal Wellness Checkup.

  2. Use the senior advice route if eligible

    People 60 or older can call 844-435-7486.

  3. Follow any provider referral

    Confirm eligibility and whether a lawyer has agreed to represent you.
sections.after: Keep copies and follow court instructions. A website guide or chatbot does not itself establish lawyer representation.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using HELP4TN tools and senior advice service. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is 844-HELP4TN the current all-age advice line?
The current homepage labels it a senior legal helpline for people 60 and older.
Is income a barrier for the senior line?
The provider says the senior line serves eligible ages regardless of income or assets.
Does the checkup provide a lawyer automatically?
It supplies a personalized resource report; follow the relevant legal provider’s intake.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
